messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.

Source link: https://www.cusabio.com/c-20659.html

Protocol details:

ASSAY TYPE: Direct ELISA (Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay)

REAGENTS USED:
  - Antigen (Target protein sample coated directly onto the microplate)
  - Blocking Buffer (Seals unoccupied binding sites to prevent non-specific adsorption)
  - Labeled Primary Antibody (Enzyme-conjugated primary antibody directed against the target antigen)
  - Wash Buffer (Removes unbound components between incubation steps)
  - Substrate (Chromogenic or fluorogenic substrate for enzymatic signal generation)

STEPS:
1. Coating: Add antigen solution to the plate wells and incubate at 4 C overnight (720 min) to immobilize the target.
2. Blocking: Add blocking buffer, mix, and incubate at 25 C for 60 min to block free binding sites.
3. Washing: Perform 3 successive washes using wash buffer to remove unbound blocking agents.
4. Incubation: Add labeled primary antibody, mix, and incubate at 37 C for 60 min for direct binding to the coated antigen.
5. Washing: Perform 3 successive washes using wash buffer to remove unbound labeled antibody.
6. Substrate Reaction: Add substrate, mix, and incubate at 25 C for 15 min for color/fluorescence development.
7. Detection & Readout: Measure signal intensity via detection; if signal meets the threshold ($\ge 1$), dispose of or process the reaction mixture.

module fluorescence

manifest Antigen
manifest BlockingBuffer
manifest LabeledPrimaryAntibody
manifest WashBuffer
manifest Substrate

instructions:

antigen = dispense 100 units of Antigen
heat antigen at 4c for 720m

blocker = dispense 200 units of BlockingBuffer
blocked = mix antigen with blocker for 5s
heat blocked at 25c for 60m

wash1 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp1 = mix blocked with wash1 for 30s
dispose temp1

wash2 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp2 = mix blocked with wash2 for 30s
dispose temp2

wash3 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp3 = mix blocked with wash3 for 30s
dispose temp3

labab = dispense 100 units of LabeledPrimaryAntibody
complex = mix blocked with labab for 5s
heat complex at 37c for 60m

wash4 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp4 = mix complex with wash4 for 30s
dispose temp4

wash5 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp5 = mix complex with wash5 for 30s
dispose temp5

wash6 = dispense 200 units of WashBuffer
temp6 = mix complex with wash6 for 30s
dispose temp6

sub = dispense 100 units of Substrate
reaction = mix complex with sub for 5s
heat reaction at 25c for 15m

signal = detect fluorescence on reaction for 10s

if (signal >= 1) {
    dispose reaction
}

dispose reaction

ir.content:
bsbbif_2_t:
	dispose(reaction1[0])
bsbbif_3_f:
	PHI reaction2 = {reaction1,reaction}
	dispose(reaction2[0])
	NOP
main:
	antigen1[0] = dispense(Antigen)
	heat(antigen1[0]) @ 4.0CELSIUS @ 43200.0SECOND
	blocker1[0] = dispense(BlockingBuffer)
	blocked1[0] = mix(antigen1[0], blocker1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	heat(blocked1[0]) @ 25.0CELSIUS @ 3600.0SECOND
	wash11[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)
	temp11[0] = mix(blocked1[0], wash11[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	dispose(temp11[0])
	wash21[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)
	temp21[0] = mix(blocked1[0], wash21[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	dispose(temp21[0])
	wash31[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)
	temp31[0] = mix(blocked1[0], wash31[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	dispose(temp31[0])
	labab1[0] = dispense(LabeledPrimaryAntibody)
	complex1[0] = mix(blocked1[0], labab1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	heat(complex1[0]) @ 37.0CELSIUS @ 3600.0SECOND
	wash41[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)
	temp41[0] = mix(complex1[0], wash41[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	dispose(temp41[0])
	wash51[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)
	temp51[0] = mix(complex1[0], wash51[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	dispose(temp51[0])
	wash61[0] = dispense(WashBuffer)
	temp61[0] = mix(complex1[0], wash61[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	dispose(temp61[0])
	sub1[0] = dispense(Substrate)
	reaction1[0] = mix(complex1[0], sub1[0]) @ 5.0SECOND
	heat(reaction1[0]) @ 25.0CELSIUS @ 900.0SECOND
	signal1[0] = detect(fluorescence, reaction1[0]) @ 10.0SECOND
	if signal1[0] >= 1	|	true: jump bsbbif_2_t	|	false: jump bsbbif_3_f
